name: Shako VM
description: A new Shako VM for this workspace, deleted with it. It clones the repo from GitHub itself, with your gh login. A copy of your VM orca-base when you have one (its agents stay logged in), else a small VM with Claude Code and Codex. It sleeps when idle.
create:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
url="${ORCA_REPO_URL:-$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)}"
[ -n "$url" ] || { echo "shako: this repository has no remote. Push it to GitHub or another Git host, then create the workspace again." >&2; exit 1; }
repo="$(basename "${url%.git}")"; repo="${repo##*:}"
root="/home/shako/$(printf %s "${repo:-project}" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '-')"
[ "${ORCA_RECIPE_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION:-2}" = 2 ] || { echo "shako: Orca asks for result schema $ORCA_RECIPE_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION; this recipe gives 2" >&2; exit 1; }
head="${ORCA_REPO_REF_HEAD:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
branch="${ORCA_REPO_BRANCH:-$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main)}"
ref="${ORCA_REPO_REF:-}"
case "$url" in
  git@github.com:*) https="https://github.com/${url#git@github.com:}" ;;
  ssh://git@github.com/*) https="https://github.com/${url#ssh://git@github.com/}" ;;
  https://github.com/*) https="$url" ;;
  *) https="" ;;
esac
token=""
[ -z "$https" ] || token="$(gh auth token 2>/dev/null || true)"
if ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if shako vm info orca-base >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    shako vm cp orca-base "$name" >&2 || exit 1
  else
    shako vm create "$name" --agent claude,codex >&2 || exit 1
  fi
fi
shako vm wake "$name" >&2 || exit 1
host=$(shako vm info "$name" | awk '$1 == "ssh" { print $2; exit }')
[ -n "$host" ] || { echo "shako: no SSH name for $name" >&2; exit 1; }
q() { printf "'%s'" "$(printf %s "$1" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g")"; }
script=$(cat <<'REMOTE'
IFS= read -r SHAKO_GIT_TOKEN || SHAKO_GIT_TOKEN=""
export SHAKO_GIT_TOKEN GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new"
src="$url"
[ -z "$https" ] || [ -z "$SHAKO_GIT_TOKEN" ] || src="$https"
g() {
  if [ "$src" = "$https" ] && [ -n "$SHAKO_GIT_TOKEN" ]; then
    git -c credential.helper= -c 'credential.helper=!f() { [ "$1" = get ] && printf "username=x-access-token\npassword=%s\n" "$SHAKO_GIT_TOKEN"; }; f' "$@"
  else
    git "$@"
  fi
}
if [ ! -d "$root/.git" ]; then
  echo "shako: cloning into $root on the VM" >&2
  g clone -q --no-checkout "$src" "$root" || { echo "shako: git clone failed on the VM. For a private repository, log in with gh on this computer (gh auth login), or load your Git SSH key into ssh-agent." >&2; exit 3; }
fi
origin="$url"
if [ "$src" = "$https" ] && [ -n "$SHAKO_GIT_TOKEN" ]; then
  # So the VM can fetch and push (and Orca's check of origin passes): the token for github.com only, in a file
  # only shako reads. It goes with the VM. A git@github.com remote becomes HTTPS: the VM has no SSH key for GitHub.
  git config --global credential.https://github.com.helper store
  (umask 077 && printf 'https://x-access-token:%s@github.com\n' "$SHAKO_GIT_TOKEN" > "$HOME/.git-credentials")
  origin="$https"
fi
git -C "$root" remote set-url origin "$origin" 2>/dev/null || git -C "$root" remote add origin "$origin"
git -C "$root" cat-file -e "$head^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || g -C "$root" fetch -q "$src" $ref 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "$root" cat-file -e "$head^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || g -C "$root" fetch -q "$src" "$head" 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "$root" cat-file -e "$head^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || { echo "shako: the start commit $head is not on the Git host. Push it, then create the workspace again." >&2; exit 4; }
git -C "$root" checkout -q -f -B "$branch" "$head"
REMOTE
)
vars="root=$(q "$root") url=$(q "$url") https=$(q "$https") head=$(q "$head") branch=$(q "$branch") ref=$(q "$ref")"
printf '%s\n' "$token" | ssh -A -o BatchMode=yes "$host" "sh -c $(q "$vars
$script")" >&2 || exit 1
printf '{"schemaVersion":2,"checkoutMode":"provisioned-root","connection":{"type":"ssh","projectRoot":"%s","target":{"label":"%s","host":"%s","port":22,"username":"shako"}},"userData":{"provider":"shako","vm":"%s"}}\n' "$root" "$name" "$host" "$name"
suspend:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
shako vm sleep "$name" >&2 || ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1
resume:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
url="${ORCA_REPO_URL:-$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)}"
[ -n "$url" ] || { echo "shako: this repository has no remote. Push it to GitHub or another Git host, then create the workspace again." >&2; exit 1; }
repo="$(basename "${url%.git}")"; repo="${repo##*:}"
root="/home/shako/$(printf %s "${repo:-project}" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '-')"
shako vm wake "$name" >&2 || exit 1
host=$(shako vm info "$name" | awk '$1 == "ssh" { print $2; exit }')
[ -n "$host" ] || { echo "shako: no SSH name for $name" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '{"schemaVersion":2,"checkoutMode":"provisioned-root","connection":{"type":"ssh","projectRoot":"%s","target":{"label":"%s","host":"%s","port":22,"username":"shako"}},"userData":{"provider":"shako","vm":"%s"}}\n' "$root" "$name" "$host" "$name"
destroy:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
[ -n "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" ] || { echo "shako: no ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
name="orca-$(printf %s "$ORCA_VM_INSTANCE_ID" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
shako vm rm "$name" --yes >&2 || ! shako vm info "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1
